task_spec: A parameter whose type already brackets its metavar (e.g. Choice renders [a|b|c]) must NOT be wrapped in a second pair of brackets in the usage synopsis -- an optional Choice should read [a|b|c], not [[a|b|c]]. (pallets/click#3578)

bugs.description: make_metavar wraps an optional parameter's metavar in [ ] whenever not self.required, without checking whether the type already bracketed it. For Choice/DateTime (which render their metavar as [a|b|c]) this produces a double-bracketed [[a|b|c]] in the usage synopsis. The fix guards with `and not already_bracketed`.
bugs.seed_note: NATURAL post-cutoff bug: inverse of pallets/click PR #3578.
